report_comment.text: TPM3 encodes a tropomyosin isoform that associates with actin filaments. NTRK1 encodes TRKA, a neurotrophin receptor tyrosine kinase. TPM3::NTRK1 chimeric transcripts have been detected in colorectal adenocarcinomas by targeted RNA sequencing. The reported junctions join an amino-terminal partner to the carboxy-terminal TRKA region. An oncogenic NTRK fusion without a known acquired TRK resistance mutation is a larotrectinib biomarker in adults and children with advanced solid tumors after progression or without satisfactory alternatives; the indication also requires metastatic disease or surgery associated with severe morbidity.
